shortDescription: Manage DNS security profiles in FortiManager

options.name: adom
options.description: The ADOM the configuration should belong to.

options.name: block_action
options.description: Action to take for blocked domains. choice | block | Return NXDOMAIN for blocked domains. choice | redirect | Redirect blocked domains to SDNS portal.

options.name: block_botnet
options.description: Enable/disable blocking botnet C&C; DNS lookups. choice | disable | Disable blocking botnet C&C; DNS lookups. choice | enable | Enable blocking botnet C&C; DNS lookups.

options.name: comment
options.description: Comment for the security profile to show in the FortiManager GUI.

options.name: external_ip_blocklist
options.description: One or more external IP block lists.

options.name: ftgd_dns_filters_action
options.description: Action to take for DNS requests matching the category. choice | monitor | Allow DNS requests matching the category and log the result. choice | block | Block DNS requests matching the category.

options.name: ftgd_dns_filters_log
options.description: Enable/disable DNS filter logging for this DNS profile. choice | disable | Disable DNS filter logging. choice | enable | Enable DNS filter logging.

options.name: ftgd_dns_options
options.description: FortiGuard DNS filter options. FLAG Based Options. Specify multiple in list form. flag | error-allow | Allow all domains when FortiGuard DNS servers fail. flag | ftgd-disable | Disable FortiGuard DNS domain rating.

options.name: log_all_domain
options.description: Enable/disable logging of all domains visited (detailed DNS logging). choice | disable | Disable logging of all domains visited. choice | enable | Enable logging of all domains visited.

options.name: mode
options.description: Sets one of three modes for managing the object. Allows use of soft-adds instead of overwriting existing values.

options.name: redirect_portal
options.description: IP address of the SDNS redirect portal.

options.name: safe_search
options.description: Enable/disable Google, Bing, and YouTube safe search. choice | disable | Disable Google, Bing, and YouTube safe search. choice | enable | Enable Google, Bing, and YouTube safe search.

options.name: sdns_domain_log
options.description: Enable/disable domain filtering and botnet domain logging. choice | disable | Disable domain filtering and botnet domain logging. choice | enable | Enable domain filtering and botnet domain logging.

options.name: sdns_ftgd_err_log
options.description: Enable/disable FortiGuard SDNS rating error logging. choice | disable | Disable FortiGuard SDNS rating error logging. choice | enable | Enable FortiGuard SDNS rating error logging.

options.name: youtube_restrict
options.description: Set safe search for YouTube restriction level. choice | strict | Enable strict safe seach for YouTube. choice | moderate | Enable moderate safe search for YouTube.
